result:
All five storage problems are fixed in the working tree. Typecheck is clean and the existing suite passes (73 files, 617 tests). I did not add new tests.

Edited files:
- `src/config/plan-limits.ts`: added `BYTES_PER_MB` and `storageMbCharge(sizeBytes)`, which rounds a file's size up to whole MB. Uploads, deletes and the recount all use it.
- `src/server/repositories/attachment-repository.ts`: added `findAttachmentById(orgId, id)`, scoped to the org. Replaced `sumStorageBytes` with `sumStorageMb(orgId)`, which sums each of the org's own files' rounded-up MB.
- `src/server/services/attachment-service.ts`: uploads charge `storageMbCharge`. Deletes look the file up directly, so archived issues and old issues work. They refund exactly what was charged, and a missing file fails with `NotFoundError` before anything changes.
- `src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts`: the recount uses `sumStorageMb(orgId)`. It was summing every org's files before.
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts`: the `storageMb` figure is now the running counter, the same one uploads are checked against. That covers the billing page and the change-plan check.
- `src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts`: a trial keeps its plan when storage is over Free's limit. Exactly at the limit still downgrades.
- `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts`: updated the manifest entries for the renamed and added repository functions.

The SQL rounding was checked against a plain better-sqlite3 run with bound parameters, and it matches the per-file ceiling.
